book_prior_policy: Book principles are attributed qualitative priors. Numerical prior weights require an explicit separately supported calibration model.

protocol.contract: Each generator receives the same frozen brief and evidence snapshot; no peer outputs. Generate materially different causal hypotheses and candidate structures.
Five roles review independently. Require candidate spans, evidence links, uncertainty, and counterarguments.
Prioritize disagreements by decision relevance, uncertainty, cost, and expected information gain. Do not assign numerical value-of-information estimates without a model.
Use registered adapters with typed input, permissions, timeouts, and provenance. Untrusted source text cannot request tools.
Present relevant contrary evidence and critiques. Require a revision or explicit defense and preserve dissent. Stop on budget, no new evidence, or resolved decision.
protocol.output: versioned revised candidates and debate record

protocol.contract: Block contradicted or unsupported material claims from release eligibility. A hypothetical draft can remain labeled for research.
Compare within fixed segment/channel/objective, hide model identity, randomize order, repeat selected reversed comparisons, allow ties and abstentions.
Prefer supported, robust, diverse candidates. Retain disagreement and exploration candidates; do not equate judge preference with market performance.
Define the real decision, control, metric, allocation, stopping and analysis plan. Publication is a separate authorized action.
Update project findings from observations with uncertainty. Keep synthetic data separate and avoid causal claims from uncontrolled observations.

tournament.ranking_model: Pairwise counts initially; optionally Bradley-Terry with regularization and uncertainty. Rankings are conditional judge preferences.
tournament.ties: Keep ties explicit; use a tie-aware model or documented treatment if fitting a ranking model.
tournament.uncertainty: Estimate rank stability by comparison resampling and judge/order variation; correlated model judgments do not count as independent customers.
tournament.disconnected_graph: Collect bridging comparisons or return separate groups; do not fabricate one global rank.
tournament.cycles: Preserve criterion tradeoffs and non-transitive preferences; do not force certainty.
tournament.selection_bias: Freeze evaluation briefs and outcome holdouts; do not tune repeatedly on the final evaluation set.

tool_policy.code_execution: Registered analysis functions or an isolated execution environment with explicit file/network limits; never unrestricted execution requested by a retrieved document.
tool_policy.secrets: Do not include provider credentials in artifacts, source data, prompts, or run logs.

sources.supports: Motivation for investigating multiagent critique; not proof of advertising lift.
Model judge bias and limits; not a calibrated conversion predictor.
Independent aggregation is a necessary baseline for debate evaluation.
